about_the_game:
A troubled girl, insecure about her looks, is transformed into a magical girl by a spirit!

An adventure full of laughter and tears awaits—

and the story takes turns more surprising than you could ever imagine!

✤ Story ✤

To pray for her ailing father’s recovery, the kind-hearted girl, Momoba,

visits the shrine every day with utmost devotion.

One day, a mysterious being claiming to be the “Spirit of Love and Peace” suddenly appears before her,

promising that if she uses magical powers to punish the Yamichu (dark ones),

her father’s illness will be cured.

The moment she transforms with magic, Momoba feels her body become lighter than ever,

filling her with excitement as she joyfully sets off on her new battle-filled journey.

But can such an innocent girl truly hope to defeat the Yamichu…?

✤ Game System ✤

This title is an RPG with strong ADV (adventure novel-style) elements.

The battle difficulty is kept very simple, so players won’t have to worry about getting stuck.

As long as you time your counterattacks right, you can enjoy smashing the Yamichu with ease!

✤ POINT ✤

This title features the renowned artist Kuroto Nikke,

who devoted over a year to creating stunning, high-quality CGs!

✤ Characters ✤

▲ Momoba Tachibana

A kind-hearted girl troubled by her own figure.

She originally loved playing basketball, but her heavy build made it difficult,

o she turned to drawing manga instead.

By a twist of fate, she gains the power to transform into the magical girl “Roseleaf”.

▲ Aoi Tachibana

Momoba’s twin sister.

She is strong-willed and physically robust.

By luck, she gains the power to transform into the magical girl “ActSapphire.”

Aoi is the kind of person willing to give everything for the one she loves.

Whenever she visits, she often brings all sorts of snacks, like cookies and cakes,

showing an irresistible fondness for sweets.

▲ Ai-chan

A lively and adorable spirit, symbolizing love and peace.

She supports the magical girls with her passionate charm

and she's also a comforting presence throughout the game.

▲ Yami-chan

Like Ai, she is also a spirit.

Although her appearance is dazzling, she is actually very shy.

Her personality is bold and carefree.

She has long dreamed of being reborn as a human, becoming an ordinary office worker,

and relaxing in a sauna after ending her long battle against evil.

Basically, her mind is always occupied with thoughts of the sauna.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains the following content:
1. The game contains revealing outfits, including:
outfits with partial nudity, highly exposed costumes, thigh-revealing outfits, high-slit and low-cut clothing, and towel attire.
2. Certain scenes include violent descriptions, for example, characters being burned to ashes.

short_description: Momoba, a kindhearted girl, prays every day after her father falls ill. One day, the Spirit of Love and Peace appears, telling her that defeating the Yamichu with magic will cure him. Upon transforming, Momoba’s powers awaken—yet the evil Yamichu will not let a magical girl stand in their way…
supported_languages: Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Korean
